dedupe_keys.name: situation journaliere des barrages dans le bassin du tensift

description: Situation journalière des barrages dans le bassin du Tensift is a data set listed in Morocco national open data portal (data.gov.ma), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Agence du bassin hydraulique de Tensift. Ce fichier présente la situation journalière des réserves en eau des principaux barrages dans le bassin du Tensift durant le mois d’août 2026. Il fournit, pour chaque barrage et pour chaque jour, la réserve en eau en millions de mètres cubes (Mm³) ainsi que le taux de remplissage en pourcentage (%). Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Agence du bassin hydraulique de Tensift. Its tags are Situation, Tensift, barrages, bassin, journalière. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-ma-portal.
